lines.text: The people gathered in the square before the Water Gate, and Ezra read the Law aloud from daybreak until noon.
On the second day, the family heads, priests and Levites gathered around Ezra to study the words of the Law.
Ezra opened the book in full view, and all the people sat down and worshiped the LORD with their faces to the ground.
The people brought back branches from the hill country and made booths on rooftops, in courtyards, and by the Water Gate.
The assembly made booths and lived in them, and Israel had not celebrated like this since the days of King David.
